slug.description: Active game slug. Assets are stored per game under .forgeax/games/<slug>/assets/3d/. The workbench UI fills this automatically for manual use; an AI/agent caller MUST pass the active game's slug (e.g. 'mini-gta'). Required.

assetName.description: Desired base file name (without extension). Sanitized + de-duplicated by the store.

views.description: Named view-slot image URLs. front_image_url is required; others optional.

provider.description: Generation provider. Defaults to hunyuan_workflow. Meshy uses an ordered image array (front/back/left/right). Rodin attaches images with condition_mode=concat; mock-first until its key is supplied.

providerParams.description: Provider-specific native params (validated server-side against shared/provider-params.ts; unverified/inapplicable fields are dropped). See docs/PROVIDER_PARAMS.md.
